title: Daily News Quiz · 2026-07-30
headline: Coffee linked to dramatically lower risk of liver disease and liver cancer

questions.prompt: Who was the first author of the coffee and liver study?
questions.hintKo: Dr. Kim of Cedars-Sinai Medical Center was the first study author.

questions.prompt: What conditions did coffee consumption reduce the risk of?
choices: Cirrhosis, liver cancer, and liver-related death
questions.hintKo: The study specifically looked at liver conditions: cirrhosis, liver cancer, and liver-related death.
CNN published the article on July first, twenty twenty-six.

choices: The United Kingdom, using UK Biobank data
questions.hintKo: The research was based on the UK Biobank study population.

questions.prompt: Why do the benefits appear to come from antioxidants rather than caffeine?
choices: Because the study only looked at tea drinkers
Because coffee beans have no caffeine
Because decaffeinated drinkers showed similar benefits to regular coffee drinkers
Because caffeine was proven harmful to the liver
questions.hintKo: The similar results in decaf drinkers point to antioxidants as the source of the benefits.

questions.prompt: How many participants were followed in the study?
questions.hintKo: The study followed more than 354,000 participants.
